# Proposal: Autogenerated API Documentation for Native Classes (`molsysmt.native`)

> **Status:** Pending Revision  
> **Date:** August 2026

## 🎯 Overview

Currently, form API documentation pages are organized under `docs/api/form/` (e.g. `docs/api/form/molsysmt_MolSys/api_molsysmt_MolSys.rst`). However, native classes (`molsysmt.MolSys`, `molsysmt.Topology`, `molsysmt.Structures`, `molsysmt.MolecularMechanics`, `molsysmt.MolSysBuilder`) are native Python class definitions living under `molsysmt.native.*` (or `molsysmt.*`).

## 📋 Action Items for Implementation
1. **Autodoc Generation in `docs/api/native/`**: Build sphinx `autoclass` or `autosummary` API reference pages for native classes directly from their class docstrings under `docs/api/native/` (e.g. `docs/api/native/molsysmt_MolSys.rst`).
2. **Cross-Link Integration**: Update `{doc}` links in `docs/content/user/foundations/native_world/classes/` to point directly to `docs/api/native/<ClassName>.rst`.
